# Loading R package
```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(pheatmap, dplyr)
```


# Read the data file
```{r}
df <- read.table("data/taxonomy_s_top5.tsv", header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
metadata <- read.table("data/metadata.tsv", header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")

# annotation_col <- metadata
annotation_col <- select(metadata, Location)
ann_colors = list(
  Location = c(Sichuan = "#1B9E77", Zhongshan = "#D95F02", Jiangmen = "#E7298A")
)
```

```{r}
# Drawing
pheatmap(df, scale = "column", clustering_method = "complete", clustering_distance_rows = "correlation", cutree_cols = 6, border = F, treeheight_row = 30, treeheight_col = 30, fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 6, angle_col = 45, fontsize = 8, cellheight = 10, annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_colors = ann_colors, color = colorRampPalette(c("#6890B5", "white", "#B64141"))(100), width = 12, height = 8, filename="taxonomy_s_top5.pdf")

```
